title: buxus sempervirens subsp. hyrcana
intro: Buxus sempervirens subsp. hyrcana, commonly known as Iranian boxwood or Persian boxwood, is a species of flowering plant in the family Buxaceae. It is a type of evergreen shrub or small tree that has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The plant is also known for its therapeutic actions, which include acting as an anti-anxiety and antispasmodic agent, and its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and tannins that contribute to its medicinal properties. The therapeutic actions of Buxus sempervirens subsp. hyrcana are attributed to its ability to interact with the body's nervous and cardiovascular systems, promoting relaxation and reducing stress.
